name: 我喜欢的人变成猫是怎样的体验
original_name: 我喜欢的人变成猫是怎样的体验
overview: Qin Sumu, a doctor who turns into a cat each night, is adopted by Ai Duoduo, a young woman who once misjudged him. As they grow close, he falls in love, faces a rival suitor, and together they navigate magical trials and misunderstandings to discover their true feelings and find happiness.
